import socketio
from typing import Dict, Any

sio = socketio.AsyncServer(async_mode="asgi")

@sio.on("subscribe_device_feed", namespace="/webrtc")
async def on_subscribe_device_feed(sid: str, data: Dict[str, Any]):
    session = await sio.get_session(sid, namespace="/webrtc")
    if not session or not session.get("authenticated"):
        await sio.disconnect(sid, namespace="/webrtc")
        return

    target_device_id = data.get("device_id")
    room_name = f"device_stream_{target_device_id}"
    await sio.enter_room(sid, room_name, namespace="/webrtc")
    await sio.emit("feed_subscribed", {"device_id": target_device_id}, room=sid, namespace="/webrtc")
diagnosis: The WebRTC signaling handler adds the socket client into device_stream_{target_device_id} solely based on device_id in the message payload. It fails to check if the authenticated session user owns or is granted access to that device, allowing unauthorized users to join signaling rooms and intercept live audio/video feeds.
corrected_code:
import socketio
from typing import Dict, Any

sio = socketio.AsyncServer(async_mode="asgi")

@sio.on("subscribe_device_feed", namespace="/webrtc")
async def on_subscribe_device_feed(sid: str, data: Dict[str, Any]):
    session = await sio.get_session(sid, namespace="/webrtc")
    if not session or not session.get("authenticated"):
        await sio.disconnect(sid, namespace="/webrtc")
        return

    target_device_id = data.get("device_id")
    device_auth = sio.environ[sid]["app.device_auth"]
    if not await device_auth.user_has_access(session.get("user_id"), target_device_id):
        await sio.emit("error", {"detail": "Forbidden: unauthorized device feed access"}, room=sid, namespace="/webrtc")
        return

    room_name = f"device_stream_{target_device_id}"
    await sio.enter_room(sid, room_name, namespace="/webrtc")
    await sio.emit("feed_subscribed", {"device_id": target_device_id}, room=sid, namespace="/webrtc")
